defects.problem: Shared prototype breadcrumb rendered only an immediate list/empty state; approved loading/error/retry scenes were missing.
defects.fix: Scoped synthetic directory component with key-bound display state, cancelled timers, explicit slow/permission-recovery demo inputs and real retry UI. No production runtime change.

boundaries: E01 A actual five-level CJK/same/same/CJK/same ancestors; each popup full location, exact marker and child paths checked. Initial tree populated actual-native caches; popup cache reuse is not falsely described as five fresh IPC calls. I mounts real Breadcrumb→Store→registered original controller→native with a trusted own static source resolver and faithful sender/frame. It additionally opens level3 marker and verifies real bytes.

E02 A genuine original files.list empty success held after authenticated native IO, no former leaf painted in loading, close popup/open another ancestor then release unchanged result; new ancestor unchanged. Return empty shows explicit empty. Actual own denied directory chmod000 yields original PERMISSION; chmod700 + actual retry yields permission-child.txt, no lingering error. No OS permission dialog or clipboard.

I three tests cover five ancestors/exact open, delayed original-success delivery and real empty/permission/retry; original outputs compared by SHA. OS application-discovery listing is an unrelated empty-app fixture only, not an applications test. Actual file list/open/read/permission is original RPC/native. Existing nested-root2 and directory-race6 regressions yield final11pass0skips. Initial premature buffer assertion (2pass/1fail) fixed by waiting actual loaded bytes; first broad run omitted old SMARTDD_FILES_NATIVE_PATH opt-in (5pass/6not-selected), rerun with both actual paths11pass.

P complete shared FileWorkspace file region, synthetic data and explicit slow600ms / one permission failure then retry recovery. Four light/dark scenes plus six task-close/scope regressions. Scenario selector is explicit DOM select/change fixture configuration after keyboard selection was unconfirmed; actual breadcrumb/file-directory/retry controls use pointer and menu dismissal keys. Timers cancel on directory/unmount, state keyed by directory/scenario/attempt/entries so old rows never paint a different prefix. No native/OS/pixel claim.

P red scene control absent after E01light passed; old prototype immediate ready/empty did not implement loading/error/retry design states. Added only approved states/demo controls, no production bug invented. First external A driver omitted a scoped require; setup failed before original list wrapper installation, corrected. Initial prototype pnpm build lacked local vite command; repository root Vite6.4.4 binary built successfully6.45s and prepared Sites assets. Failures/logs retained, no dependency installation or network use.

No production source change. Reuse exact r43 ASAR/broker and six prior package-native smokes;81out/ASAR files freshly equal.983source final differs from980onlyP FileWorkspace and3new external test files. Two new source archives retain P state-gap baseline and tested final. Native self-owned7file hashes/inodes/mtime unchanged; chmod directory metadata change intentional.

Original list handler function identity restored; held success released with unchanged hash. CANCELLED list observations from ordinary lazy-tree requests are preserved, not fabricated errors or case failures. No tasks, models, oldr4/r6pending57bytes, AIS/daily resources, clipboard or OS permissions touched. Historical1776not a fresh full suite; old2externalCLIopt-ins not selected. Stage active, no commit/push/merge/tag/release.
